about: Evidence for the Simulation Theater V2 NFL team colour map (app/src/lib/simulation-theater/nfl-team-colors.mjs). Data only: no component imports it, it never ships in a bundle, and the colour-literal scanner (lib/uiux/color-scan.mjs, .ts/.tsx/.mjs/.css) does not read .json. Hex values only, no logo or brand asset stored. dev-route-colors.test.mjs recomputes every flag and every derived value from this file.

rules.validated: A source AGREES with a team when it lists colours within CIE76 ΔE ≤ validationDeltaE of BOTH the map's primary and its secondary. official = some official source agrees; agree = sources from two independent families agree (nflHeader, nflLogo and wiki are one family, NFL.com's); validated = official || agree.
rules.roles: primary = the team's primary brand colour (score-bug block, end zone); secondary = its main contrasting brand colour (the away block/end zone when the primaries collide); accent = an official colour that carries the team on the field (drive ribbon, end-zone edge, timeline fills, scoring flash, possession tag). Since iteration 5 every role value is listed VERBATIM by at least one official source (officialSources below).
rules.contrast: Text on a team block (ink, and the trim used for end-zone lettering) ≥ 4.5:1 on that block. On-field accents ≥ 3:1 against both turf stripes (and so the darker page). An official accent under 3:1 is painted, for the on-field use only, as its first legible hue-keeping lightening (field-geometry.mjs turfSafeAccent: brighten first, then mix toward white, 5 % steps); the official value stays the brand reference (derivedUi).
rules.collisions: CIE76 ΔE < 20 between the two primaries → the away block and end zone use the away secondary, or are hatched when that collides too. The two on-field accents are checked the same way → the away side uses the official alternative (secondary, primary, or a recorded alternate) that no longer collides and needs the smallest on-field adjustment (≤ 35 ΔE), else its timeline segments are hatched.

nflHeader.name: NFL.com team page, profile-header colours (overlay, stripe)

nflLogo.name: NFL.com club logo SVG, fill colours (league-hosted club mark; white omitted)

caveats: No team's or the NFL's brand-guide PDF was publicly reachable; therams.com/brand/ is password protected and was not entered.
Many Wikipedia values are byte-identical to NFL.com's, so Wikipedia is grouped in NFL.com's family and never counts as independent of it.
NFL.com renders every black as #000000, including the Panthers', whose own site uses #101820; a club's own value outranks NFL.com's.
The league-hosted DEN logo is the legacy 'D' mark; DEN's current colours come from NFL.com's header.
matchupsNote: Every matchup in the 2026 shadow receipts (the theater's possible fixtures): the palette theaterPalette() paints, recomputed by the test.

HOU.decision: Accent white (no source) → battle red #EB0028 (NFL.com header, the logo, houstontexans.com). H-Town blue #0080C6 (houstontexans.com theme accent2) is recorded as the official alternate the field uses when the opponent's accent is another red (e.g. HOU @ TEN).
HOU.iteration4Note: Primary changed #03202F → #021018 (ΔE 9.9) and secondary #A71930 → #EB0028 (ΔE 33.1): the club's own site, NFL.com's header and the league-hosted logo all use deep steel blue #021018 and battle red #EB0028 (2024 identity). Accent stays white.

IND.decision: Made official-exact: #002C5F → #013369 (NFL.com header, the league-hosted logo) and silver #A2AAAD → #A5ACAF (NFL.com header).

JAX.decision: Founder decision 2026-10-18: teal #006778 is the primary (NFL.com's header stripe; also in the league-hosted logo), black #000000 the secondary (NFL.com's header overlay, the logo), gold #D7A22A the accent (the logo's main gold). Gold is 2.8:1 on teal and black 3.1:1, under the 4.5:1 text rule, so the block's trim and the end-zone lettering use the white ink; gold carries the team on the field.
JAX.iteration4Note: Primary changed #101820 → #000000 (ΔE 10.4): both league sources render Jaguars black as #000000 (logo also #0A0B09) and jaguars.com carries no value. Secondary gold #D7A22A is exactly in the league-hosted logo, so it stays; teal #006778 (NFL.com's header stripe) is also official and is the alternative, but gold is the mark's main colour after black.

NYJ.decision: Values made official-exact: Gotham green #115740 (NFL.com header and the league-hosted logo; teamcolorcodes' #125740 is ΔE 0.2). club.where: club-customised nav accent --dropdown-hover-bkg-var (other clubs keep the league default)

TB.decision: Primary = Buccaneer red #A71930 (NFL.com header, the league-hosted logo, buccaneers.com's own nav accent). Secondary = pewter #322F2B, NFL.com's exact header value (replaces teamcolorcodes' #34302B, ΔE 1.0). Accent = the logo's brighter red #C2242B, the officially published value that replaces the unsupported #D50A0A; on the turf it is 2.0:1, so the field paints a brightened #C2242B (derivedUi).
TB.iteration4Note: Primary changed #D50A0A → #A71930 (ΔE 34.3): NFL.com's header, the league-hosted logo and buccaneers.com's own nav accent all use #A71930. Pewter #34302B is ΔE 1.0 from the official #322F2B. Accent NOT changed: #A71930 is 2.70:1 on the page (< 3:1), so the review's #D50A0A stays as the accent; the official logo's #C2242B (3.43:1) is the founder's alternative.

club.where: brand page (March 2026 rebrand): the 'Colors and typography' graphic's colour proportions, largest first, name Titans blue, white, navy and red (names only, no hex); the page's own carousel buttons use #4495d2. The navigation red #D50A0A is the league platform default, not counted.

TEN.decision: Roles from the club's own brand page (tennesseetitans.com/brand, March 2026 rebrand): its 'Colors and typography' graphic gives the colour proportions, largest first, Titans blue, white, navy, red. So primary = Titans blue #4495D2 (NFL.com header overlay, the league-hosted logo, the brand page's own UI), secondary = navy #001532 (NFL.com header stripe; the brand page names navy but prints no hex), accent = red #D50A0A (the league-hosted Titans logo's red). White is the ink's job. The red on tennesseetitans.com's navigation is the league platform's default (#D50A0A on 12 other club sites), so it is not counted as club evidence; the logo is.
TEN.iteration4Note: Primary changed navy #0C2340 → Titans blue #4495D2, secondary #4B92DB → red #D50A0A, ink white → dark, accent → #4495D2. The March 2026 rebrand made Titans blue the dominant colour (club brand page and NFL.com); red is the shield logo's and the number outlines' colour (league-hosted logo). NFL.com's header pairs navy #001532 instead, the alternative secondary. tcc still lists the pre-2026 palette.

WSH.decision: No change in iteration 5. Primary and secondary as the official sources list them (nflHeader, nflLogo; nflHeader, nflLogo); accent #FFB612 = the secondary (nflHeader, nflLogo).
